On motion to recommit with instructions Failed by recorded vote: 190 - 228 (Roll no. 482). (consideration: CR H5791)
The previous question on the motion to recommit with instructions was ordered without objection. (consideration: CR H5791)

DEBATE - The House proceeded with 10 minutes of debate on the Barber motion to recommit with instructions. The instructions contained in the motion seek to require the bill to be reported back to the House with an amendment to add a section to the bill to provide funds to acquire the most advanced firefighting and safety equpment.
Mr. Barber moved to recommit with instructions to Natural Resources. (consideration: CR H5790-5792; text: CR H5790)
The House adopted the amendment in the nature of a substitute as agreed to by the Committee of the Whole House on the state of the Union.
